remarks: Set on over one gorgeous acre of property at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this super-clean, meticulously maintained home has just been professionally painted throughout and is truly move-in ready. Best of all, landscaping is included in your base rent!  This one-level living home features central air conditioning, a two-car garage with a convenient breezeway, three spacious bedrooms, and two full bathrooms. Inside, you'll find a bright, inviting eat-in kitchen and a huge dining and family room, offering plenty of space for entertaining family and friends.  Enjoy the privacy and tranquility of an expansive property while still being conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, making commuting and getting around a breeze. A 2-minute drive to the nearest riding and boarding equestrian center! Private, peaceful, beautifully maintained, and ready to welcome you home!
